description: This source file defines the AndroidProjectIndexBridge object, which provides an interface for discovering project modules and key activity entries within the Android application. It serves as a root bridge that facilitates analysis by referencing core activities and modules.

methods.name: modules
methods.description: Returns an array of module names as strings representing different parts of the project, such as :app, :list, and :utilities.

methods.name: entries
methods.description: Returns an array of fully qualified class names for core activities within the app, including various UI activities.
